data.textDisplay: Wow, thank you for this video. I am 65, and no matter what I do, the fine and so fine lines show up.  I just found you, and I subscribed to you. Wish me luck. 😊

Your channel popped up this morning and I'm so glad it did! I'm 64 and the struggle is real sisters, so these tips will come in handy, and I will try this today! Hey, I may be an old dog, but I love, love, love new tricks!

I can honestly say I would be happy if my undereyes looked like the "bad" photo in your thumbnail. My wrinkles are so bad and any concealer cracks and looks crepey.  Adding any powder whatsoever is just death sentence for me.
You're either going to get creasing or coverage--finally someone said it! Thank You!
The important thing is to take care of yourself and you are gonna like yourself
Wait till you are 60 😹😹😹

Love this. I do use a color corrector from Huda which gets me 87% of the way, but then when I’ve added concealer on top, crinkle dry city. I’ve not thought about going in with this level of precision. I’ll have to do some experimenting.

Your strategic application was a game changer for me, I’d previously adopted your method after seeing videos & couldn’t be happier. Not only looks better with no creasing/cracking but it wears better throughout the day meaning I don’t look like a dried out stone goblin after a few hours. 
Combining the Colleen Rothschild made for even better results, you turned me onto that product as well :)
Funny how I always thought it was the product or powder when really it was just me over applying, over blending and following advice more geared for photography/film and not real life.
You are so sweet -  "You don't have to buy what I am using"  such a change of pace from others.   Your technique is great.  You know what you are doing.  Thanks for sharing!

I'm so thrilled and Thankful to have found You with these under eye techniques!!
I have severe dark circles. 
Without doing my under eyes people look at me and exclaim, "Oh. My. Goodness! Are you okay??! Did someone hit you???" 
Uuuugh, that drives me CrAzY!
Thank you so much for the save!
Hope everyone here has a beautiful day today. 
🎉❤🎉❤
Thank you so much..... You're the first person who has said you're going to have to put up with either a bit of dark circle still showing or creasing!
Such an excellent technique. Trying it next time I do my makeup. You don't give us BS and you call out BS. Love that about your channel.

My under eyes look better now than they did 10 years ago. I use the Sisley concealer and the Colleen Rothchild after a good moisturizer. I don’t need a powder under the eyes due to dryness and it still lasts. I do use a finishing powder on my cheeks and anywhere else I need some CT flawless pressed powder. If I needed a colour corrector CT does make one that neutralizes darkness perfectly. Other than my eyelids getting a little droopy my eyes look good. Thanks Anne for the tips especially the Sisley and Colleen Rothchid.   I am still on my first tube and there is a lot left so it’s worth it. It pays for itself. Take care. ❤😁
My tear troughs are so deep and inset that I feel like I need to put a glob of play dough under my eyes cuz I can't afford derma filler. I have retinol cream that I use under my eyes.

I swear- I’m 48- Jewish heritage so I have dark circles. Also have lines and tear troughs are there.. 
if you take one of those velour triangle puffs, spray some nyx matte finishing spray on it and tap under eyes after powder- voila- no creasing

Awesome video, Anne!!!…You always have the best information, tips, everything!!!!…more people need to follow you!!!!…they have no clue on what they are missing!!!..,your honesty, passion and compassion are bar none!!!!!…your skin looks fabulous!!!!…I bought the Calcem eye cream!!…it is amazing!!!!…my milia is almost totally gone now from the Halo and Horns, All About The Base exfoliator!!!!…my skin at 68 has never looked better just from that!!..I have been getting so many compliments on my skin, it is mind blowing!.,,I never heard the word glowing about my skin in 68 years, until using that product!!!…..much love and appreciation for you, girlfriend!!!!..always!!!💜💜💜💜💜💜
Your hair looks beautiful, pulled back 👏💓
Your eye makeup is so pretty. Please do a video on how to achieve this look.
I probably have 20+ concealers, I will try this!! TY!!❤❤❤
You will help people with this video. You've helped me in the past. Thanks, Anne.
